title: Vacant-Home Care Rates for In-Place Home Resale Packages
content:
**Property services rate sheet — vacant homes on In-Place Home Resale files.** While a home for sale stands vacant it receives the required monthly vacant-home check, and at the communities with freezing winters it is winterized. The package figures are:

| Package | Monthly vacant-home check included | Monthly vacant-home check fee (USD per month) | Winterization fee (USD per winter) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Resale Approval Service | No | 45.00 | 185.00 |
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package | No | 45.00 | 185.00 |
| Assisted Resale Listing | No | 45.00 | 185.00 |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage | Yes | 0.00 | 185.00 |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | Yes | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Guaranteed Resale Program | Yes | 0.00 | 0.00 |

**Winterization months (every package):** November, December, January, February and March — calendar months 11, 12, 1, 2 and 3. These are the months during which a vacant home at Cedar Hollow or Conestoga Meadows, the communities with freezing winters, must be winterized.

**Reading the sheet.** On the Full-Service Resale Brokerage the monthly check is included (0.00) but a winterization is billed at 185.00; on the Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus and the Guaranteed Resale Program both are at 0.00; on the first three packages the monthly check fee is 45.00 and the winterization fee 185.00.
